candidates.name: Whipple disease
support_spans: marked expansion of the lamina propria by a dense mixed inflammatory infiltrate predominantly composed of pale histiocytes with vacuolated cytoplasm
The histiocytes contained numerous basophilic spherical and targetoid inclusions that were strongly positive on von Kossa and periodic acid–Schiff stains
candidates.why: The presence of pale histiocytes with vacuolated cytoplasm and basophilic inclusions positive on von Kossa and periodic acid-Schiff stains is characteristic of Whipple disease.
